R1.description: A validation answer for a satisfy action launches /satisfy-gate <stage> <id> on a new satisfy-gate role, and every other pairing, role, worker kind or rendering is blocked as before

R2.description: A run passes plan approval, technical approval and acceptance through the validator under automatic gates, a refused validation stops without a retry and sends no approval_recorded

R3.description: A closed enum in a protocol 1.x answer never refuses the answer: every enum location has a stated rule, the seven already-open ones keep their exemptions, a test over the schema holds the list, and a protocol major change still refuses

R4.description: A gate the Workflow calls blocked sends lane_blocked; a gate that needs a person, including an external_gate under an automatic gate until C10b and C10c, keeps user_gate

R5.description: The roadmap, the guides and an ADR agree with the behaviour, and the checks and the suite are green
